title: What Happens Inside an AI When You Hit Enter? #shorts
description:
How a large language model turns your prompt into an answer, in under a minute: tokens, embeddings, attention, next-token prediction, and the generation loop.

Full 3-minute version on my channel.

#AI #LLM #HowAIWorks #MachineLearning #shorts

lines: What happens inside an AI when you hit Enter?
Here it is, in under a minute.
First, your text is chopped into tokens, and each token becomes a number.
Each number becomes a vector: a long list of numbers that captures meaning.
Then dozens of transformer layers run attention, so every word can look at every other word.
At the top, the model scores every possible next token, and picks one.
Then it adds that token to the input, and runs again.
One token at a time. That's why answers stream in, word by word.
